messages:
Alex: FYI scheduling v2 rollout for api.redwood.ai on Wed 2025-06-18 20:00 UTC. Change window 1h. We'll skip a small set of tenants (see below). DeployBot will run preflight and canary. @team please confirm release notes update and rollback criteria.

Priya: I'll take release notes. Do we include schema changes, header examples, and a short troubleshooting section for integrators? Also need a small migration blurb for mobile SDKs.

Alex: Yes — adding schema diff + header sample. Example header: `X-API-Version: v2` (clients can also send `Accept-Version: v2`). Snippet I'll put in notes:
```
# sample header
X-API-Version: v2
```

Jamie: Quick note on client behavior — SDKs older than 2.1 don't set the header and will remain on v1. Do we have a tenant pinlist to force v1 for fragile tenants?

Marc: We maintain a tenant pinlist for backcompat. Current candidates to skip in canary: tenant_omega, tenant_acme, tenant-legacyX. Recommend adding tenant-beta-stable to be safe.

Alex: Ok. Draft skiplist I'm going to push to deploybot: tenant_omega, tenant_acme, tenant-legacyX, tenant-beta-stable. Any objections?

Sandra: Add tenant-finance to skiplist — they requested zero-change during fiscal close.

Alex: Added. Final skiplist: tenant_omega, tenant_acme, tenant-legacyX, tenant-beta-stable, tenant-finance.

DeployBot: preflight checks passed for deploy-20250618-4321. image: redwood/api:v2-20250618-rc3; capacity estimate: 1200rps; canary plan: 1% traffic -> 60s ramp -> 30m steady. Health checks: OK. Build log: http://ci/internal/builds/4321

Ellen: Rollback criteria (auto): 1) sustained 5xx rate >1.5x baseline for 5m, 2) median latency increase >200ms sustained for 5m, 3) health-check failures on >2/3 replicas. If any trigger, auto-rollback to last stable v1. Manual rollback allowed via `/deploy rollback <id>`. Ops will monitor for encoding/tokenization error spikes too.

Priya: Can we add a soft alert (not auto-rollback) for token-cost spike? We saw a cost regression last month due to encoding changes.

Marc: Yes — add metric `tokens_per_request_p50` spike >25% as an ops alert (pager if sustained >15m). Keep it out of auto-rollback for now.

Jamie: Canary rollout proposal: 1% for 30m, if green -> 5% for 30m -> 25% for 1h -> full. Ops to watch latency/5xx/encoding errors during each stage. If any stage shows regression, stop and roll back.

Alex: Release notes plan: I'm pushing a draft to `/docs/releases/v2-20250618.md` in ~90m. Priya will finalize and publish release notes + migration guide.

DeployBot: scheduled deploy queued: deploy-20250618-4321 at 2025-06-18T20:00:00Z. Operators tagged: @Ellen @Marc @Jamie. To abort: `/deploy abort deploy-20250618-4321`

Sandra: :thumbsup: I'll keep eyes on tenant-finance and tenant-legacyX during the window.

Alex: Thanks all. Tagging @oncall for visibility. Please have eyes on dashboards 20:00-21:30 UTC and call it out in #incidents if anything weird.
